name: C12-14 alcohols ethoxylated propoxylated
description: C12-14 alcohols ethoxylated propoxylated (CAS 68439-51-0 ) is a nonionic surfactant derived from mid-chain fatty alcohols modified with both ethylene oxide and propylene oxide blocks. The dual alkoxylation profile allows formulators to tune hydrophilic-lipophilic balance, foam profile, and solubility behavior to meet specific targets. In industrial and institutional cleaning concentrates, it delivers effective degreasing with controlled low-foam characteristics. This is particularly valuable in spray, CIP, and machine-wash processes where foam management is critical for operational efficiency. Textile and leather processing operations use it as an emulsifier and wetting agent in scouring baths, dyeing auxiliaries, and finishing formulations. It provides excellent surface tension reduction and penetration properties across various substrate types. In coatings and adhesive systems, it functions as a dispersing agent to stabilize pigment and filler suspensions. This ensures a uniform distribution of particles and prevents sedimentation during storage or application of the final product. Personal care formulators incorporate it into rinse-off products where mild emulsification and skin-compatible cleansing are required. Its versatile nature allows it to be used in a wide range of cosmetic and household detergent applications. C12-14 alcohols ethoxylated propoxylated is typically supplied as a liquid or low-viscosity paste, depending on the EO/PO ratio of the specific grade. Technical and industrial grades are the most common commercial forms available for large-scale manufacturing. Product specifications vary by ethoxylation and propoxylation degree to suit different HLB requirements. Bulk liquid supply in IBC containers and drums is standard across the market to ensure efficient logistics and handling for chemical distributors.
